environment.description: Same EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) running identical Flask monolith. Instance has a custom AppArmor profile 'community-board' loaded in enforce mode that confines the gunicorn worker processes. The profile restricts network socket operations to bind/listen/accept only on port 8080 and denies capability 'net_raw'. Additionally, the instance runs behind an internal ALB with a CloudFront distribution in front. The CloudFront distribution has a response headers policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) that injects 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'none\'; style-src \'self\' \'unsafe-inline\'; img-src \'self\'; frame-ancestors \'none\'' on ALL origin responses. The AppArmor profile also denies write access to /var/www/static/ preventing any file-based payload staging, and the SQLite database path is the only writable location allowed (/var/lib/app/comments.db). CloudFront cache behaviors are configured with TTL 0 for dynamic content (path pattern: /*) ensuring the CSP header is always freshly applied from the response headers policy, not from a stale cache without it.

config.direct_access: security group allows inbound only from ALB security group
